'''620C''' was a turbine [[Podracer engine/Legends|engine]] designed by [[Radon-Ulzer/Legends|Radon-Ulzer]] specifically for [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]]. This type of engine was used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] for his [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|custom Podracer]], with several modifications.
